releaseNotes: THE BIG ONE — ACCOUNT SWITCHER IN EVERY CLONE: the switcher is no longer Discord-only. EVERY clone you create now has a small draggable ⎄ button floating inside the app — tap it and the Ophelia quick menu opens: switch accounts (one clone, many logins, NO logout), add accounts, rename them, update the clone itself. Works in WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Roblox, any clone. Drag the button wherever you like (it remembers), hold it 600ms to hide it for the session.
Discord clones keep ALL the extras: Set Status (Online/Idle/DND/Invisible) in the menu, the Switch Accounts row above Quests in your profile panel, and hold-your-profile-tab gesture.

OLD CLONES: after updating, open the cloner — the red banner at the top (“N clones are missing the new Ophelia engine”) now counts ALL old clones, not just Discord ones. Update all → every clone gets the ⎄ button, in place, logins and data untouched.

Clones also know which app they were built from now (recorded inside the clone) — so the in-clone “Update this clone” button works for every app, and it can tell when the ORIGINAL app on your phone is newer than the clone.

IF PLAY PROTECT BLOCKS THIS UPDATE (“Harmful app blocked”, no Install-anyway): Play Store → your profile picture → Play Protect → gear → turn OFF “Scan apps with Play Protect” → tap Update again. That verdict is Google's server-side call on apps that re-sign other apps (the original App Cloner has been flagged the same way for years) — nothing in the app changed to cause it. You can turn scanning back on afterwards.
switcherReleaseNotes: dex v5 — GENERIC: every clone gets the draggable ⎄ bubble (tap = quick menu, drag = move + edge-snap, hold = hide for session); Discord-only extras (status rows, profile-tab hold, in-panel rows) are gated at runtime by the host probe.
The clone's source app is recorded as ophelia_source_package meta-data at patch time — the in-clone update center finds the ORIGINAL app for any host now (Discord fallback preserved for v4 clones).
Snapshot/restore engine unchanged and already host-agnostic (shared_prefs + databases + files, media skipped).
